key.name: layout
key.description: Which layout the menu opens in: classic, a menu window attached to the panel button, or launcher, a full-screen app grid.

key.name: search-position
key.description: Where the search entry sits: top or bottom of the menu window, or panel, beside the panel button. In the launcher layout top and bottom both put it at the top of the screen.

key.name: favourite-apps
key.description: Ordered list of desktop entry IDs shown in the favourites column. IDs of applications that are not installed are kept, so a favourite returns when its application is reinstalled.

key.name: label-visible
key.summary: Show a label on the panel button
key.description: Show a label next to the icon on the panel button. Labels are always hidden on vertical panels.

key.name: label-text
key.description: Text of the panel button label. Empty for the translated default, "Menu".

key.name: icon-name
key.description: Name of the icon theme icon shown on the panel button.

key.name: rollover
key.description: In the classic layout, hovering a category selects it instead of needing a click.

key.name: hot-key
key.description: Name of the key that opens and closes the menu when pressed and released on its own. Empty for no key.
